page.overview:
Who is Saitank?

Saitank is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates' Armored Division. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Saitank is a muscular man with a square jaw. He wears a light green helmet with spikes in the middle, a sleeveless fur coat with a jewelled chain, metal shoulder plates, a pair of white gloves, and a belt. From the waist down, he is fused to a large rhinoceros, with a metal brace on its horn and a tattoo of a skull with horns on its forehead. On the rhino's back, behind Saitank's upper body, is a large chair with the word "SASAKI" written on it, which Sasaki uses as a throne when commanding the Armored Division.

Saitank appears to be very loyal to the Beasts Pirates, and does not seem to have a problem with firing on Kouzuki Momonosuke, a child. In the anime, he appears to be cold-hearted, laughing alongside the rest of the Armored Division when Sasaki made fun of the Kouzuki Family.

As a Gifter, Saitank has eaten a |Sai no Sumairu}}, giving him a massive rhinoceros fused to his waist that replaces his legs. His human torso appears to be growing out from behind the rhinoceros' neck.
